VOCAB.en_def: animal skin that is treated and used to make bags, shoes, and clothes

VOCAB.collocation: genuine leather 真皮

VOCAB.en_def: a strong, heavy cloth used for bags, shoes, and tents
VOCAB.sentence: A: The bookstore wants to sell its own shopping bags, but the manager does not want plastic because many customers care about the environment, so which material should we use? VOCAB.collocation: a canvas bag 帆布袋

VOCAB.en_def: not letting water go through
VOCAB.sentence: A: I will be visiting construction sites in Keelung all next week, and the weather report says it will rain almost every day, so how can I keep my documents dry? B: Use a {{BLANK}} bag with a roll-top opening, because even heavy rain cannot get inside, and your plans and contracts will stay completely dry.
VOCAB.cn: A：下週我整週都要去基隆的工地，氣象報告說幾乎每天都會下雨，我要怎麼讓文件保持乾燥？ B：用一個捲口式開口的【防水】包，因為就算大雨也進不去，你的設計圖和合約都能保持完全乾燥。
VOCAB.collocation: a waterproof jacket 防水外套

VOCAB.en_def: able to last a long time without breaking
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our delivery workers carry heavy packages in their bags all day, and the cheap bags we bought last year all fell apart within a few months, so what should we buy now? B: We need more {{BLANK}} bags made of thick nylon with strong stitching, even if they cost more, because they will last for several years and save money.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們的送貨員整天用包包背重物，去年買的便宜包包幾個月內就都壞了，我們現在該買什麼？ B：我們需要更【耐用】的包包，用厚尼龍和堅固的縫線製成，即使比較貴，因為它們能用好幾年，反而省錢。
VOCAB.collocation: durable materials 耐用的材料

VOCAB.en_def: not heavy
VOCAB.sentence: A: The flight attendants at our airline walk through long airports every day with their bags, and many of them have complained about sore backs, so what can we do? B: We can give them new {{BLANK}} bags that weigh less than one kilogram when empty, so they will carry much less weight during long workdays.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們航空公司的空服員每天都要提著包包走過很長的機場，很多人抱怨背痛，我們能怎麼做？ B：我們可以發給他們空包重量不到一公斤的新款【輕量】包包，這樣他們在漫長的工作日中就能少背很多重量。
VOCAB.collocation: a lightweight suitcase 輕量行李箱

VOCAB.en_def: having a lot of room inside
VOCAB.sentence: A: I am going to Singapore for a week-long sales conference, and I need to bring business suits, product samples, and a laptop, so will my small bag be enough? B: No, you will need a more {{BLANK}} suitcase, because the samples take up a lot of room, and you may also bring back gifts from the clients.
VOCAB.cn: A：我要去新加坡參加為期一週的業務會議，需要帶西裝、產品樣品和筆電，我的小包包夠用嗎？ B：不夠，你需要一個更【寬敞】的行李箱，因為樣品很佔空間，而且你可能還會帶客戶送的禮物回來。
VOCAB.collocation: a spacious main compartment 寬敞的主隔層

VOCAB.en_def: small and using little space
VOCAB.sentence: A: Many young office workers in Taipei ride scooters to work, and they say large bags are hard to store under the seat, so what product should we design for them? B: We should design a {{BLANK}} bag that fits easily under a scooter seat but still holds a tablet, a wallet, and a raincoat.
VOCAB.cn: A：台北很多年輕上班族騎機車通勤，他們說大包包很難放進座墊下，我們該為他們設計什麼產品？ B：我們應該設計一款【小巧】的包包，能輕鬆放進機車座墊下，但還是能裝平板、皮夾和雨衣。
VOCAB.collocation: a compact design 小巧的設計

VOCAB.en_def: popular and in a style that many people like now
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our bags are well made and practical, but sales to young customers have been falling this year, so what do you think is the main problem? B: Young people want bags that look {{BLANK}}, so we should work with a popular designer and add brighter colors and modern shapes to our collection.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們的包包做工好又實用，但今年賣給年輕顧客的銷量一直下滑，你覺得主要問題是什麼？ B：年輕人想要看起來【時髦】的包包，所以我們應該和受歡迎的設計師合作，在產品系列中加入更亮的顏色和現代的造型。
VOCAB.collocation: fashionable accessories 時髦的配件

VOCAB.en_def: practical and useful, made to do a job well
VOCAB.sentence: A: The customer survey shows that business travelers do not care much about the color of a bag, so what do they want most when they choose one? B: They want a {{BLANK}} bag with many pockets, a laptop section, and a charging port, because they need to work in airports and hotels.
VOCAB.cn: A：顧客調查顯示商務旅客不太在意包包的顏色，那他們挑選時最想要的是什麼？ B：他們想要一個【實用】的包包，有很多口袋、筆電夾層和充電孔，因為他們需要在機場和飯店工作。
VOCAB.collocation: a simple, functional design 簡單實用的設計

VOCAB.en_def: the amount that something can hold
VOCAB.sentence: A: The hiking company wants to know which backpack it should rent to customers for the two-day mountain tour, because some customers carry a lot of clothes. B: Choose the one with a forty-liter {{BLANK}}, because it holds clothes, food, and water for two days, but it is still light enough for most people.
VOCAB.cn: A：登山公司想知道兩天山區行程該出租哪一款背包給客人，因為有些客人會帶很多衣服。 B：選四十公升【容量】的那一款，因為它能裝兩天份的衣服、食物和水，而且對大多數人來說還是夠輕。
VOCAB.collocation: a large storage capacity 大的收納容量

VOCAB.en_def: to arrange things in a neat and useful way
VOCAB.sentence: A: My bag is always so messy that I cannot find my pens, business cards, or keys when a client is waiting, and it makes me look unprofessional. B: You should {{BLANK}} your things with small pouches, putting each type of item in its own place, so you can find anything in a few seconds.
VOCAB.cn: A：我的包包總是很亂，客戶在等的時候我都找不到筆、名片或鑰匙，讓我看起來很不專業。 B：你應該用小收納袋來【整理】你的東西，把每一類物品放在固定的位置，這樣幾秒鐘就能找到任何東西。
VOCAB.collocation: organize your desk 整理你的桌面

VOCAB.en_def: to hold something and take it with you
VOCAB.sentence: A: The new rules at the factory say that workers cannot bring large bags onto the production floor, so where should they keep their personal things? B: They can only {{BLANK}} a small clear bag with their phone and water bottle, and everything else must stay in the lockers near the main entrance.
VOCAB.cn: A：工廠的新規定說工人不能帶大包包進入生產區，那他們的私人物品要放哪裡？ B：他們只能【攜帶】一個裝手機和水壺的小透明袋，其他東西都必須放在大門附近的置物櫃裡。
VOCAB.collocation: carry a heavy bag 提重包包

VOCAB.en_def: to put things into a bag or suitcase for a trip

VOCAB.cn: A：我飛東京的班機明天早上七點起飛，今晚在辦公室還有很多工作要做，我什麼時候才有時間準備？ B：你一到家就應該先【打包】行李，再做其他事，這樣你才能早點睡，也不會忘記任何重要的東西。
VOCAB.collocation: pack a suitcase 打包行李箱

VOCAB.en_def: to go from one place to another, especially far away

VOCAB.cn: A：我們業務經理兩週後要去日本、韓國和泰國，她只會帶一個包包，她該帶哪一種？ B：她會帶一個登機箱輕裝【出差】，因為可以帶上飛機，在每個機場都不必等行李。
VOCAB.collocation: travel light 輕裝旅行

VOCAB.en_def: able to be used again and again

VOCAB.cn: A：超市明年想停止提供塑膠袋，但有些購物者可能會不高興，我們要怎麼幫助他們改變習慣？ B：我們可以在結帳處附近販售便宜的【可重複使用】購物袋，並給自己從家裡帶袋子的顧客小折扣。
VOCAB.collocation: reusable shopping bags 可重複使用的購物袋

VOCAB.en_def: the part of a bag that you hold in your hand

VOCAB.collocation: a leather handle 皮革提把

VOCAB.en_def: safe and protected from being opened or stolen
VOCAB.sentence: A: Many tourists in our city have complained about pickpockets in crowded night markets, so what kind of bag should our travel shop recommend to them? B: We should recommend a {{BLANK}} bag with hidden zippers and a lock, so thieves cannot open it easily while people are walking through crowds.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們城市很多觀光客抱怨在擁擠的夜市遇到扒手，我們旅行用品店應該推薦他們什麼樣的包包？ B：我們應該推薦有隱藏式拉鍊和鎖的【安全】包包，這樣人們走在人群中時，小偷就不容易打開。
VOCAB.collocation: keep your valuables secure 保管好你的貴重物品

VOCAB.sentence: A: The new pizza restaurant near our office is always full at lunchtime, and people say the pizza base is soft but crispy, so what is their secret? VOCAB.en_def: a liquid mix of flour, eggs, and milk used for cakes or pancakes
VOCAB.sentence: A: The breakfast shop is going to start selling pancakes next month, but the cooks are worried that they will be too slow during the morning rush, so what can they do? VOCAB.en_def: a powder made from wheat, used to make bread and cakes
VOCAB.sentence: A: The price of our bread has gone up twice this year, and some customers have started to complain, so why are our costs rising so fast? VOCAB.en_def: a substance used to make bread rise and become soft
VOCAB.sentence: A: The new baker's bread came out flat and hard this morning, and we had to throw away three trays of rolls, so what went wrong in the kitchen? VOCAB.en_def: a sweet substance used in food and drinks
VOCAB.sentence: A: Many of our customers have asked for healthier cakes because they are trying to eat better, but they still want them to taste good, so what should we change? VOCAB.en_def: a soft yellow food made from cream
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our croissants are much more expensive than the ones at the supermarket, and some customers ask why they should pay more, so what should we tell them? VOCAB.cn: A：我們的可頌比超市的貴很多，有些顧客問為什麼要多付錢，我們該怎麼告訴他們？ B：告訴他們我們用的是真正的法國【奶油】，讓我們的可頌有濃郁的風味和許多輕盈酥脆的層次，這是便宜可頌沒有的。

VOCAB.sentence: A: The new kitchen helper is making cookies for the first time, and she is not sure what to do after measuring all the ingredients, so can you help her? B: Tell her to {{BLANK}} the butter and sugar first until they are soft and smooth, and then slowly add the eggs and the flour.
VOCAB.cn: A：新來的廚房助手第一次做餅乾，她量好所有材料後不確定接下來要做什麼，你能幫她嗎？ B：告訴她先把奶油和糖【攪拌】到柔軟滑順，然後再慢慢加入蛋和麵粉。

VOCAB.sentence: A: The bakery is thinking about buying a large machine for making bread dough, but it costs a lot of money, so is it really worth it? VOCAB.cn: A：麵包店考慮買一台製作麵團的大型機器，但要花很多錢，真的值得嗎？ B：值得，因為我們的烘焙師每天早上要花將近兩小時用手【揉】麵團，而機器只要十五分鐘就能做好同樣的工作。

VOCAB.sentence: A: Why do the bakers come to work at four o'clock in the morning, when the shop does not open until seven thirty? B: The bread dough needs about two hours to {{BLANK}} before it goes into the oven, so they must start very early to have fresh bread ready when customers arrive.

The _____ of his contract came as a shock to the sales manager. He had worked at the firm for twelve years.
After the safety test failed, the city ordered a two-week _____ of the cable car service. Engineers will inspect every part.
The hikers had to _____ their plan to reach the top because of the thick fog. They returned to the hotel before dark.

The court agreed to _____ the sale of the land because the seller had lied. The buyer will get all of his money back.
This coupon is _____ if it is copied or sold. Please bring the original to the store before the end of the month.
The new tax will _____ most of the savings we made by moving to a cheaper office. Our accountant is looking for other solutions.
The concert was cancelled, so all ticket holders will receive a full _____. The money will return to their credit cards within ten days.
Delivery is free for orders over fifty dollars. For smaller orders, there is a small _____ of five dollars for shipping.
According to the company's travel _____, employees must book economy class for flights under five hours. Managers may approve exceptions.
The workers were told about the factory closing with only one week's _____. Many of them were angry and worried about their jobs.
The _____ for submitting this year's sales reports is Friday at noon. Late reports will not be included in the review.
Customers who return the rental car late must pay a _____ of thirty dollars per hour. Please check the return time carefully.
The gym charges a monthly _____ of forty dollars. Members can use the pool and the sauna at no extra cost.
The results of the customer survey were completely _____. Nobody on the research team had predicted that people would prefer the older design.
All of a _____, the lights went out in the middle of the presentation. The speaker calmly continued by using a flashlight.

VOCAB.cn: A：氣象報告說這週末會有強烈颱風，伴隨大雨和強風，我們該把公司車放在哪裡？ B：請在週五傍晚把所有車都移到辦公大樓下方的地下【車庫】，因為在外面樹枝和飛落物很容易把它們弄壞。

VOCAB.cn: A：我們的送貨車從一月以來已經跑了一萬多公里，有兩位司機說煞車感覺很軟，我們該怎麼辦？ B：我們下週應該把它們全部送到經銷商那裡【保養】，讓技師在真正出問題之前檢查機油、煞車和輪胎。
VOCAB.collocation: have the car serviced 把車送去保養

VOCAB.en_def: to fix something that is broken or damaged
VOCAB.sentence: A: Someone backed into my car in the shopping mall parking lot on Sunday and broke the back door, so how long will it take to fix? B: The body shop told me they can {{BLANK}} the damage in about three days, and the insurance company will pay for most of the cost because the other driver admitted it.
VOCAB.cn: A：週日有人在購物中心停車場倒車撞到我的車，撞壞了後車門，要多久才能修好？ B：鈑金廠告訴我他們大約三天就能【修理】好損壞的地方，而且因為對方駕駛承認了，保險公司會支付大部分費用。
VOCAB.collocation: repair the damage 修復損壞

VOCAB.en_def: how fast something moves

VOCAB.cn: A：今天早上我收到一張罰單，是上個月上班途中在學校附近開太快，我非常驚訝。 B：那條街在上學時段的【速度】限制只有每小時三十公里，而且斑馬線附近藏了一台測速相機。
VOCAB.collocation: the speed limit 速限

VOCAB.en_def: a particular type or version of a product
VOCAB.sentence: A: The sales manager wants to replace her old company car with something more modern this year, so which car is she thinking about buying? VOCAB.cn: A：業務經理今年想把她的舊公司車換成更現代化的車，她考慮買哪一台？ B：她喜歡那家日本車廠的最新【車款】，因為它的後車廂更大可以放樣品、更省油，還有能連接手機的智慧系統。
VOCAB.collocation: the latest model 最新款

VOCAB.en_def: owned by someone before; not new
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our small catering business needs a second van for weekend events, but we don't have a large budget this year, so what are our choices? B: We could buy a {{BLANK}} van from a trusted dealer, because it costs about half the price of a brand-new one, and many come with a one-year warranty.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們的小型外燴公司週末活動需要第二台廂型車，但今年預算不多，我們有哪些選擇？ B：我們可以向信譽良好的車商買一台【二手】廂型車，因為價格大約是全新車的一半，而且很多附有一年保固。
VOCAB.collocation: a used car 二手車

VOCAB.en_def: recently made or bought; not used before
VOCAB.sentence: A: I heard that the company finally replaced the old delivery trucks that kept breaking down last winter, so how do the drivers feel about it? B: They are very happy with the {{BLANK}} trucks, which arrived straight from the factory last week, because they are quieter, cleaner and much more reliable on long trips.
VOCAB.cn: A：我聽說公司終於汰換了去年冬天一直故障的舊送貨卡車，司機們覺得怎麼樣？ B：他們對上週直接從工廠送來的【新】卡車非常滿意，因為它們更安靜、更乾淨，長途行駛也可靠得多。
VOCAB.collocation: a brand-new car 全新的車

VOCAB.en_def: not likely to cause harm or danger
VOCAB.sentence: A: My elderly parents want to buy a car for their weekend trips to the countryside, and they asked me for advice, so what should they look for? B: They should choose a {{BLANK}} car with good airbags, automatic emergency braking and high test scores, because protecting the people inside matters more than style or speed.
VOCAB.cn: A：我年邁的父母想買一台車週末去鄉下玩，他們問我的意見，他們應該注意什麼？ B：他們應該選擇一台有良好安全氣囊、自動緊急煞車和高測試分數的【安全】車款，因為保護車內的人比外型或速度更重要。
VOCAB.collocation: a safe driver 安全駕駛的人

VOCAB.en_def: making you feel relaxed and physically pleasant
VOCAB.sentence: A: The marketing team will drive six hours to the exhibition in Taichung and back on Friday, so which car should I reserve from the rental company? B: Please book the large sedan with soft leather seats and plenty of leg room, because it is much more {{BLANK}} for long trips than the small city car.
VOCAB.cn: A：行銷團隊週五要開六個小時的車往返台中的展覽，我該向租車公司預訂哪一台車？ B：請預訂那台有柔軟皮椅和寬敞腿部空間的大型轎車，因為長途旅行時它比小型城市車【舒適】得多。
VOCAB.collocation: a comfortable ride 舒適的乘坐體驗

B: There was not enough grass or water for their {{BLANK}}, so they had to buy expensive feed and sell many cows and sheep at low prices, and some families are now in serious debt.
VOCAB.cn: A：去年夏天長期乾旱之後，當地農民為什麼向政府請求經濟援助？ B：他們的【家畜】沒有足夠的草和水，所以他們必須購買昂貴的飼料，並以低價賣掉許多牛羊，有些家庭現在負債很嚴重。
VOCAB.collocation: raise livestock 飼養家畜

VOCAB.en_def: the time when crops are collected, or the crops that are collected
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why are apple prices at the supermarket so much higher this month than they were at the same time last year? B: A strong storm hit the main growing region just before the {{BLANK}}, so farmers lost almost half of their fruit, and the stores now have to import apples from overseas.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼超市這個月的蘋果價格比去年同期高那麼多？ B：就在【收成】之前，一場強烈的暴風雨襲擊了主要產區，農民損失了將近一半的果實，現在商店只好從國外進口蘋果。
VOCAB.collocation: a good rice harvest 稻米豐收

VOCAB.en_def: farming; growing crops and keeping animals
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why is the university offering new courses on drones and computer programs for students in the farming department? B: Modern {{BLANK}} uses technology to check soil, water crops and count animals, so graduates who understand these tools can find better jobs and help farms produce more food with fewer workers.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼大學要為農學系的學生開設無人機和電腦程式的新課程？ B：現代【農業】會利用科技來檢測土壤、灌溉作物和清點動物，所以懂得這些工具的畢業生能找到更好的工作，並幫助農場用更少的人力生產更多糧食。
VOCAB.collocation: invest in sustainable agriculture 投資永續農業

VOCAB.en_def: quiet and calm, without noise or trouble
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the software company move its design team from the downtown office to a small building outside the city? B: The new location is surrounded by trees and has a very {{BLANK}} atmosphere, so the designers can think clearly without traffic noise, and their work has actually improved since the move.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼這家軟體公司把設計團隊從市中心的辦公室搬到城外的一棟小建築？ B：新地點被樹木環繞，氣氛非常【寧靜】，設計師可以在沒有車聲的情況下清楚思考，而且搬過去之後他們的作品其實變得更好了。
VOCAB.collocation: a peaceful village life 寧靜的鄉村生活

VOCAB.en_def: far away from towns and cities
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why does it take so long for online orders to reach customers who live in the eastern mountains? B: Many of those homes are in {{BLANK}} areas with narrow roads and no nearby post office, so our delivery partner can only send a truck up there twice a week.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼住在東部山區的顧客要等那麼久才能收到網路訂單？ B：那些住家很多都在【偏遠】地區，道路狹窄，附近也沒有郵局，所以我們的物流合作夥伴一週只能派兩次卡車上山。
VOCAB.collocation: a remote mountain village 偏遠的山村

VOCAB.en_def: far from other places or people; alone
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the new manager of the mountain hotel quit after only three months, even though the salary was very good? B: The hotel is so {{BLANK}} that the nearest town is two hours away, and he felt lonely because he could rarely see his friends or family on his days off.
VOCAB.cn: A：山上那家飯店的新經理薪水明明很好，為什麼才三個月就辭職了？ B：那家飯店非常【偏僻】，最近的城鎮也要兩個小時車程，他休假時很少能見到朋友或家人，所以覺得很寂寞。
VOCAB.collocation: an isolated farmhouse 偏僻的農舍

VOCAB.en_def: having a lot of space; large inside
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did you and your wife decide to buy a house in the countryside instead of another apartment in the city? B: For the same price, we got a {{BLANK}} home with four bedrooms and a big garden, so the children have room to play and I can finally have a proper office for working from home.
VOCAB.cn: A：你和你太太為什麼決定在鄉下買房子，而不是在城市裡再買一間公寓？ B：用同樣的價錢，我們買到一間有四個房間和大花園的【寬敞】住宅，孩子們有空間玩，我也終於能有一間像樣的在家工作辦公室。
VOCAB.collocation: a spacious living room 寬敞的客廳

VOCAB.en_def: existing in nature; not made or caused by people
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why are so many visitors choosing the small hot spring town instead of the large resorts near the airport this winter? B: The town has protected its {{BLANK}} beauty, with forests, waterfalls and hot springs that come straight from the ground, and travelers prefer that to big hotels and shopping malls.
VOCAB.cn: A：今年冬天為什麼這麼多遊客選擇那個小溫泉鎮，而不是機場附近的大型度假村？ B：這個小鎮保存了它的【自然】美景，有森林、瀑布和直接從地底湧出的溫泉，比起大飯店和購物中心，旅客更喜歡這些。
VOCAB.collocation: natural resources 自然資源

VOCAB.en_def: recently picked or made; (of air) clean and cool
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why do you look so much healthier since you started working at the company's new office in the mountains last spring? B: I walk to work through the trees every morning, breathe clean {{BLANK}} air all day instead of city smog, and I sleep much better than I did downtown.
VOCAB.cn: A：自從你去年春天開始在公司山上的新辦公室上班後，為什麼看起來健康多了？ B：我每天早上穿過樹林走路上班，整天呼吸乾淨【清新】的空氣，而不是城市的霧霾，睡得也比住在市中心時好多了。
VOCAB.collocation: fresh country air 清新的鄉間空氣

VOCAB.en_def: simple and typical of the countryside, often in an attractive way
VOCAB.sentence: A: How should we decorate the new café so that it feels different from all the modern coffee chains on this street? B: Let's choose a {{BLANK}} style with wooden tables, old farm tools on the walls and baskets of vegetables near the counter, so customers feel like they are visiting a country kitchen.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們應該怎麼裝潢新咖啡店，讓它和這條街上所有現代連鎖咖啡店感覺不一樣？ B：我們選擇【鄉村】風格吧，用木頭桌子、在牆上掛舊農具，在櫃檯旁放幾籃蔬菜，讓顧客覺得好像來到鄉下的廚房。
VOCAB.collocation: a rustic wooden table 質樸的木桌

VOCAB.en_def: calm, quiet and peaceful
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the yoga company choose a small island for its staff training retreat instead of a conference hotel in the city? B: The island is so {{BLANK}}, with soft waves, quiet beaches and no cars at all, that the instructors can rest their minds and practice without any noise or interruptions.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼這家瑜伽公司選擇一座小島辦員工訓練營，而不是城市裡的會議飯店？ B：那座島非常【寧靜】，有輕柔的海浪、安靜的海灘，而且完全沒有車子，教練們可以讓心靈休息，在沒有噪音和干擾的情況下練習。
VOCAB.collocation: a tranquil garden 寧靜的花園

VOCAB.en_def: (of land) able to grow a lot of good crops
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the food company buy land in that river area instead of somewhere closer to its factory in the north? B: The soil there is very {{BLANK}} because the river brings rich mud every year, so the vegetables grow quickly, and the company can produce more crops while using fewer chemicals.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼這家食品公司在那片河流地區買地，而不是在比較靠近北部工廠的地方買？ B：那裡的土壤非常【肥沃】，因為河流每年都會帶來營養豐富的泥土，所以蔬菜長得很快，公司能用更少的化學藥劑生產更多作物。
VOCAB.collocation: fertile soil 肥沃的土壤

VOCAB.en_def: making very little noise; in a calm way
VOCAB.sentence: A: What did you enjoy most about the weekend you spent at your grandparents' farm after the stressful product launch? B: Early each morning I sat {{BLANK}} on the porch with a cup of tea, listening to the birds and watching the fog lift from the fields, and I didn't check my email even once.
VOCAB.cn: A：在壓力很大的產品發表會之後，你在祖父母的農場度過的那個週末，最喜歡的是什麼？ B：每天一大早，我都【安靜地】坐在門廊喝杯茶，聽鳥叫、看著霧從田野上散去，而且我連一次電子郵件都沒有檢查。
VOCAB.collocation: sit quietly by the window 安靜地坐在窗邊

VOCAB.en_def: outside, not in a building
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why does the summer camp for our employees' children have so few computer games and indoor classes this year? B: The organizers want the kids to spend most of the day {{BLANK}}, hiking, swimming in the lake and learning about plants and insects, because they think children already spend too much time looking at screens.
VOCAB.cn: A：今年為我們員工小孩辦的夏令營，為什麼電腦遊戲和室內課程這麼少？ B：主辦單位希望孩子們一天大部分時間都待【在戶外】，去健行、在湖裡游泳、認識植物和昆蟲，因為他們認為孩子們花太多時間看螢幕了。
VOCAB.collocation: spend more time outdoors 花更多時間在戶外

VOCAB.en_def: not at home or at work; at a distance
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why can't anyone reach the sales director this week, even though there is an important contract that needs his signature? B: He is {{BLANK}} on a hiking holiday in the mountains where there is no phone signal, but his assistant has permission to sign the contract for him until he returns on Monday.
VOCAB.cn: A：明明有一份重要合約需要業務總監簽名，為什麼這週沒人聯絡得上他？ B：他【不在】公司，去山上健行度假了，那裡沒有手機訊號，不過在他星期一回來之前，他的助理有權代他簽約。
VOCAB.collocation: get away from the city 遠離城市

The farmer stores hay for the winter in a large red _____. It also protects his tractors from the rain and snow.

Wind turbines have changed the _____ of the coast. Some people think they are ugly, but others say they are a sign of progress.

VOCAB.en_def: all the subjects and topics taught in a school or training program
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why is the training department hiring two new staff members before the new employees start in September? B: The director wants to update the whole {{BLANK}} for new hires, adding topics like data safety and customer care, so they need people who can design materials and plan each week.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼訓練部門要在新進員工九月報到前再聘請兩名新員工？ B：主任想要更新新進人員的整套【課程】，加入資料安全和顧客服務等主題，所以他們需要能設計教材並規劃每週內容的人。
VOCAB.collocation: design a training curriculum 設計培訓課程

VOCAB.en_def: a list of the topics, readings and dates for a course
VOCAB.sentence: A: How will I know which chapters to read before each meeting of the marketing course that the company is paying for? B: The teacher will email everyone the {{BLANK}} on Monday, and it shows the topics, reading pages and due dates for all twelve weeks, so you can plan your time.

VOCAB.collocation: follow the course syllabus 依照課程大綱進行

VOCAB.en_def: a period of time when someone is taught something
VOCAB.sentence: A: Are you free to join us for dinner after work on Thursday, since the whole team is celebrating the new contract? B: I'd love to, but I have a Spanish {{BLANK}} with a private tutor from six to seven, so I can meet you at the restaurant a little later.

VOCAB.en_def: a group of students taught together; a period of teaching
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why do you always leave the office so quickly on Wednesday evenings, even when we still have reports to finish? B: I'm taking an accounting {{BLANK}} at the community college near my apartment, and it starts at half past six, so I can't be late.

VOCAB.en_def: a talk given to a group of people to teach them about a subject
VOCAB.sentence: A: Did you find the talk by the famous economist at the business school useful for our planning meeting next week? B: Yes, her {{BLANK}} on global trade lasted two hours, and she explained clearly why shipping costs will rise next year, so I took a lot of notes for our team.

VOCAB.en_def: a meeting where a small group discusses a subject with a teacher or expert
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why is the small meeting room on the third floor booked for the whole afternoon on Friday? B: Our lawyer is leading a {{BLANK}} for the managers about the new privacy laws, and there will only be twelve people, so everyone can ask questions and discuss real cases.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼三樓的小會議室星期五整個下午都被預訂了？ B：我們的律師要為經理們主持一場關於新隱私法的【研討會】，只有十二個人參加，所以每個人都可以提問並討論實際案例。

VOCAB.en_def: a meeting where people learn a skill by doing practical activities
VOCAB.sentence: A: What should the new sales staff bring to the training on Saturday morning? B: They should bring their laptops, because the afternoon {{BLANK}} is very hands-on, and they will practice writing real emails and making short sales calls in small groups while the trainer gives them advice.
VOCAB.cn: A：新進業務人員星期六早上的培訓應該帶什麼？ B：他們應該帶筆電，因為下午的【工作坊】非常著重實作，他們會分成小組練習寫真正的電子郵件和打簡短的銷售電話，同時培訓師會給他們建議。
VOCAB.collocation: run a writing workshop 舉辦寫作工作坊

VOCAB.en_def: one separate part of a course
VOCAB.sentence: A: How much of the online safety training have you finished, since the deadline is the end of this month? B: I've completed three out of five parts, and the next {{BLANK}} is about fire safety, which takes about forty minutes, so I'll do it during my lunch break tomorrow.
VOCAB.cn: A：既然期限是這個月底，你的線上安全培訓完成多少了？ B：五個部分我已經完成三個，下一個【單元】是關於消防安全，大約需要四十分鐘，所以我明天午休時會完成它。
VOCAB.collocation: complete the first module 完成第一個單元

VOCAB.en_def: one part of a textbook or course, usually about one topic
VOCAB.sentence: A: Which part of the English textbook should we cover before the overseas clients visit our factory next month? B: Let's focus on the {{BLANK}} about giving directions and describing products, because our staff will need those skills most when they show the visitors around the production lines.
VOCAB.cn: A：下個月海外客戶參觀我們工廠前，我們應該上英文課本的哪一部分？ B：我們把重點放在關於指路和描述產品的那一個【單元】，因為員工帶訪客參觀生產線時最需要這些技能。

VOCAB.en_def: a piece of work given to someone as part of a course or job
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why are you staying at your desk so late tonight when the office is almost empty? B: I have to finish a written {{BLANK}} for my business management course, which is a ten-page report on a local company, and I must hand it in to my professor by midnight.
VOCAB.cn: A：辦公室幾乎沒人了，你今晚為什麼還這麼晚坐在位子上？ B：我得完成企業管理課的書面【作業】，是一份關於本地公司的十頁報告，而且我必須在午夜前交給教授。
VOCAB.collocation: hand in an assignment 繳交作業

VOCAB.en_def: work that a student is asked to do at home
VOCAB.sentence: A: How is your son doing at his new school since your family moved to Taipei for your job in the spring? B: He likes his teachers, but he gets a lot of {{BLANK}} every night, so I usually help him with math after dinner before I check my work emails.
VOCAB.cn: A：自從你春天因為工作全家搬到台北後，你兒子在新學校適應得如何？ B：他喜歡他的老師，但他每天晚上都有很多【功課】，所以我通常在晚餐後先幫他做數學，再查看工作郵件。
VOCAB.collocation: do homework after dinner 晚餐後寫功課

VOCAB.en_def: a planned piece of work that has a clear goal
VOCAB.sentence: A: What do students in the evening marketing program have to do to pass at the end of the term? B: Each group must complete a final {{BLANK}}, in which they create a full advertising plan for a real local business and then present it to the owner and the teacher.
VOCAB.cn: A：夜間行銷課程的學生在學期末要做什麼才能及格？ B：每一組都必須完成一個期末【專題】，為一家真實的本地商家制定完整的廣告計畫，然後向老闆和老師報告。
VOCAB.collocation: work on a group project 進行小組專題

VOCAB.en_def: the process of judging how well someone has learned or done something
VOCAB.sentence: A: How does the language school decide which level new students should join when they first arrive? B: Everyone takes a short {{BLANK}} on the first day, including a reading test and a ten-minute talk with a teacher, and then the school puts them in the right group.
VOCAB.cn: A：新生剛到時，語言學校如何決定他們應該加入哪個程度？ B：每個人第一天都要做一個簡短的【評量】，包括閱讀測驗和與老師十分鐘的對話，然後學校會把他們分到合適的組別。

VOCAB.en_def: a formal test of knowledge or skill
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why have you been reading that thick accounting book on the train every morning for the past month? B: I'm preparing for an important professional {{BLANK}} in December, and if I pass it, I can get a promotion and a higher salary at the bank next year.
VOCAB.cn: A：過去一個月，你為什麼每天早上都在火車上讀那本厚厚的會計書？ B：我在準備十二月一場重要的專業【考試】，如果通過，明年我就可以在銀行升職並拿到更高的薪水。
VOCAB.collocation: pass the final exam 通過期末考

VOCAB.cn: A：業務總監想知道我們兩百種產品中哪一種這一季最賺錢，我要怎麼快速找到？ B：只要依照總銷售額從高到低把清單【排序】，前十名產品就會出現在螢幕最上方。
VOCAB.collocation: sort the data by date 依日期排序資料

VOCAB.en_def: to show only the items that match certain conditions
VOCAB.sentence: A: I need a list of only the customers who live in Taichung for our new store opening, but the file has thousands of names. B: You can {{BLANK}} the city column so that it shows Taichung only, and then copy those rows into a new sheet for the invitation letters.
VOCAB.cn: A：為了新店開幕，我需要一份只有住在台中的顧客名單，但檔案裡有好幾千個名字。 B：你可以【篩選】城市那一欄，讓它只顯示台中，然後把那些列複製到新的工作表上寄邀請函。
VOCAB.collocation: filter the results 篩選結果

VOCAB.en_def: a list that helps you find information quickly
VOCAB.sentence: A: The new staff handbook has more than two hundred pages, so how will employees find the rules about vacation days? B: We added an {{BLANK}} at the back with key topics in alphabetical order and page numbers, so anyone can find the holiday policy in seconds.
VOCAB.cn: A：新的員工手冊有超過兩百頁，員工要怎麼找到休假天數的規定？ B：我們在後面加了一份【索引】，依字母順序列出重要主題和頁碼，所以任何人都能在幾秒內找到休假規定。
VOCAB.collocation: check the index 查閱索引

VOCAB.en_def: the act of searching a table to find matching information
VOCAB.sentence: A: How does the new price sheet show the correct cost when I type a product code into the order form? B: It does an automatic {{BLANK}} in the main product table, finds the matching code, and then brings back the latest price so you don't have to search by hand.
VOCAB.cn: A：當我在訂單表單輸入產品代碼時，新的價格表是怎麼顯示正確價格的？ B：它會在主產品表中自動進行【查找】，找到相符的代碼，然後帶回最新價格，所以你不必手動搜尋。
VOCAB.collocation: a lookup function 查找函數

VOCAB.en_def: the way text or numbers are lined up on a page
VOCAB.sentence: A: The numbers in the price column look messy on the printed copy, so what should I fix before the client meeting at two? B: Change the {{BLANK}} so all the numbers line up on the right side of each box, which makes the prices much easier to compare.
VOCAB.cn: A：價格欄裡的數字在列印版上看起來很亂，兩點的客戶會議前我該修正什麼？ B：把【對齊方式】改成所有數字都靠每一格的右側排列，這樣價格比較起來會容易得多。
VOCAB.collocation: check the text alignment 檢查文字對齊

VOCAB.en_def: a short statement of the main points
VOCAB.sentence: A: The CEO doesn't have time to read all twelve pages of the customer survey results before her flight tonight. B: Then let's write a one-page {{BLANK}} with the five most important findings and a small chart, so she can understand the main points while she waits at the airport.
VOCAB.cn: A：執行長今晚搭機前沒有時間看完十二頁的顧客調查結果。 B：那我們寫一份一頁的【摘要】，列出五個最重要的發現和一張小圖表，讓她在機場等候時就能了解重點。
VOCAB.collocation: a brief summary of the results 結果的簡短摘要

VOCAB.en_def: to put separate numbers together into one total
VOCAB.sentence: A: Each of our six stores sends its daily sales numbers in a separate file, so how can head office see the whole picture? B: The new software will {{BLANK}} the figures from all six files every evening and create one total report that managers can read the next morning.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們六家店各自用不同的檔案傳每日銷售數字，總公司要怎麼看到整體情況？ B：新軟體每天晚上會【匯總】六個檔案的數字，並產生一份總報告，讓經理們隔天早上就能閱讀。
VOCAB.collocation: aggregate data from several sources 匯總多個來源的資料

VOCAB.en_def: the quality of being correct and without mistakes
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why is the accounting team checking every number in the annual report again when they already finished it last Friday? B: The bank will use these figures to decide on our loan, so the manager wants to be sure of their {{BLANK}} before we send the report on Monday.
VOCAB.cn: A：會計團隊上週五已經完成年度報告了，為什麼還要再檢查每一個數字？ B：銀行會用這些數字來決定我們的貸款，所以經理想在週一寄出報告前確認它們的【準確性】。
VOCAB.collocation: improve data accuracy 提升資料準確性

VOCAB.en_def: the quality of always being the same in style or method
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the manager return our quarterly report and ask us to change so many small details in the tables? B: She wants {{BLANK}} across all the pages, so every table must use the same font, the same date style, and the same currency symbol from beginning to end.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼經理退回我們的季報，要我們修改表格中這麼多小細節？ B：她希望所有頁面保持【一致性】，所以每個表格從頭到尾都必須使用相同的字型、相同的日期樣式和相同的貨幣符號。
VOCAB.collocation: maintain consistency 保持一致性

VOCAB.en_def: to add the newest information to something
VOCAB.sentence: A: The price list on our website still shows last year's prices, and three customers have already called to complain about it today. B: I'll {{BLANK}} the table with the new prices right after lunch and ask the IT team to check that the website shows the correct numbers by this evening.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們網站上的價目表還顯示著去年的價格，今天已經有三位顧客打電話來抱怨了。 B：我午餐後馬上用新價格【更新】表格，並請資訊團隊確認網站在今晚前顯示正確的數字。
VOCAB.collocation: update the spreadsheet 更新試算表

VOCAB.en_def: the process of checking that information is correct or acceptable
VOCAB.sentence: A: How can we stop people from typing letters instead of numbers in the phone column of the sign-up sheet? B: We can add data {{BLANK}} to that column, so the sheet shows a warning message and refuses any entry that contains anything other than numbers.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們要怎麼防止大家在報名表的電話欄打字母而不是數字？ B：我們可以在那一欄加入資料【驗證】，這樣試算表就會顯示警告訊息，並拒絕任何包含數字以外內容的輸入。
VOCAB.collocation: data validation rules 資料驗證規則

VOCAB.en_def: made up of numbers
VOCAB.sentence: A: The new employee ID cards are ready, but why did the system reject the codes that Human Resources sent this morning? B: The system only accepts {{BLANK}} codes with eight digits, and some of the codes from Human Resources included letters, so they need to be changed before printing.
VOCAB.cn: A：新的員工識別證準備好了，但為什麼系統拒絕了人資部今天早上傳來的代碼？ B：系統只接受八位數的【數字】代碼，而人資部有些代碼包含字母，所以在列印前需要修改。
VOCAB.collocation: numeric data 數字資料

VOCAB.en_def: written words
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why can't the spreadsheet add up the prices in column D, even though they all look like normal numbers? B: Someone saved them as {{BLANK}} instead of numbers when they copied them from an email, so the program treats them like words and cannot calculate them.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼試算表無法加總D欄的價格，即使它們看起來都是正常的數字？ B：有人從電子郵件複製時把它們存成【文字】而不是數字，所以程式把它們當成字詞，無法計算。
VOCAB.collocation: convert text to numbers 將文字轉換成數字

VOCAB.en_def: not there; lost or not included
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why can't we send the shipping report to the customer yet, when the deadline is at five o'clock today? B: There are still some {{BLANK}} delivery dates in the table, so I'm calling the warehouse to get those details before we send anything to the client.
VOCAB.cn: A：今天的截止時間是五點，為什麼我們還不能把出貨報告寄給客戶？ B：表格中還有一些【缺少的】送貨日期，所以我正在打電話給倉庫索取那些細節，然後才會寄任何東西給客戶。
VOCAB.collocation: fill in missing data 補上缺漏的資料

VOCAB.en_def: to change data so that it all follows the same standard
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our offices in Japan, Korea, and the United States report sales in different currencies, so how can we compare them fairly? B: Before we build the chart, we should {{BLANK}} all the figures by changing them into US dollars, so every office is measured in the same way.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們在日本、韓國和美國的辦公室用不同的貨幣回報銷售額，我們要怎麼公平比較？ B：在製作圖表之前，我們應該把所有數字換算成美元，將它們【標準化】，讓每個辦公室都用同樣的方式衡量。
VOCAB.collocation: normalize the data 將資料標準化

VOCAB.en_def: to move data from one program into a file another program can use
VOCAB.sentence: A: The accountant from the outside firm doesn't use our company's sales program, so how can we send her the figures? B: We can {{BLANK}} the monthly sales table as an Excel file and email it to her, so she can open it easily on her own computer.
VOCAB.cn: A：外部事務所的會計師不使用我們公司的銷售程式，我們要怎麼把數字寄給她？ B：我們可以把每月銷售表【匯出】成Excel檔，再用電子郵件寄給她，這樣她就能在自己的電腦上輕鬆打開。
VOCAB.collocation: export the file as a PDF 將檔案匯出為PDF

VOCAB.en_def: to bring data from another file or program into the one you are using
VOCAB.sentence: A: The supplier sent us a list of five hundred new products, so do I need to type every item into our system by hand? B: No, you can {{BLANK}} the whole file directly into the inventory program, which will take only a few minutes and avoid typing mistakes.
VOCAB.cn: A：供應商寄給我們一份五百項新產品的清單，我需要把每個品項都手動輸入系統嗎？ B：不用，你可以把整個檔案直接【匯入】庫存程式，只要幾分鐘，還能避免打字錯誤。
VOCAB.collocation: import data from a spreadsheet 從試算表匯入資料

VOCAB.en_def: how easy something is to read
VOCAB.sentence: A: Several board members complained that last month's financial tables were too crowded and hard to follow during the meeting. B: This time, I'll improve the {{BLANK}} by using a larger font, adding more space between lines, and shading every other row in light gray.
VOCAB.cn: A：幾位董事抱怨上個月的財務表格太擁擠，開會時很難看懂。 B：這次我會使用較大的字型、增加行距，並把每隔一列塗上淺灰色，來提升表格的【可讀性】。
VOCAB.collocation: improve readability 提升可讀性

VOCAB.en_def: something you look at to get information
VOCAB.sentence: A: Should I print the list of product codes for the new sales assistants who start working at the store on Monday? B: Yes, print a copy for each of them to keep near the cash register as a quick {{BLANK}}, because they won't remember all the codes during their first week.
VOCAB.cn: A：我應該為週一開始在店裡上班的新銷售助理列印產品代碼清單嗎？ B：是的，每人印一份放在收銀機旁當作快速【參考資料】，因為他們在第一週不會記得所有代碼。
VOCAB.collocation: for future reference 以供日後參考

MCQS.q: Please put the survey results into a clear _____ before the meeting. The managers want to compare the answers by row and column.
Please _____ the customer list by last name from A to Z. That will make it easier to find each person quickly.
Each new employee gets one _____ in the attendance sheet. Their name goes in the first box, and their working days follow across.
The spreadsheet needs one more _____ on the right side. We will list each order's total cost there from top to bottom.
You can _____ the sales report to show only orders from Tainan. All the other cities will be hidden for now.
Click on the _____ where the total appears. You will see the formula that adds up all the numbers above it.
Each column needs a short _____ at the top. Without one, nobody will know what kind of information the numbers below show.
The online form will not send if a required _____ is empty. Please check that you entered your email address and phone number.
The software will _____ the weekly figures from all twelve stores. Managers will then see one total number for the whole company.
The clinic keeps a detailed _____ for every patient in its database. It includes the patient's address, appointments, and payment history.
The research team collected a huge _____ from ten thousand online shoppers. They will study it to understand buying habits in different cities.
The formula returned the wrong _____ in the profit box. The correct amount should be 12,000 dollars, not 1,200.
The price list on our website is three months old. Please _____ it with the new prices before the sale begins on Friday.
The receptionist made a new _____ in the visitor log for each guest. She wrote the guest's name and arrival time.
Please save all the dates in the same _____, such as day, month, and year. Mixing styles will cause errors in the report.
The new database has a simple _____ with three main sections. Each section holds information about customers, products, or orders.
Our branches report sales in yen, won, and dollars. We must _____ the figures into one currency before comparing them.
If you cannot find a topic in the manual, check the _____ at the back. It lists every subject with its page number.
The order form performs a quick _____ in the price table. It finds the product code and shows the latest price automatically.
The numbers in the report do not line up properly. Please change the _____ so all the figures sit on the right side.
Our accountant uses a different program from ours. Please _____ the sales table as an Excel file and email it to her.
The director asked for a one-page _____ of the survey results. She only wants the main points, not every detail.
Before we send the invoice, please check the _____ of every figure. One wrong number could cost the company a lot of money.

Keep this list of product codes near the cash register. New staff can use it as a quick _____ during their first week.
The manager wants to see only unpaid invoices. Please _____ the list so that paid invoices do not appear on the screen.

VOCAB.en_def: a day when people do not go to work or school
VOCAB.sentence: A: Is the office going to be open next Monday, or should I tell my clients to call back on Tuesday instead? B: Monday is a national {{BLANK}}, so the whole building will be closed, but our customer service team will still answer emails from home in the afternoon.

VOCAB.collocation: a public holiday 國定假日

VOCAB.en_def: a period of time spent away from work, often traveling

VOCAB.en_def: a short time when you stop working to rest
VOCAB.sentence: A: You have been sitting at your desk and typing that sales report since eight o'clock this morning, so aren't you tired? B: Yes, my eyes really hurt, so I'm going to take a short {{BLANK}} and walk to the café downstairs for a coffee before I finish the last section.

VOCAB.en_def: time that you are allowed to be away from your job

VOCAB.cn: A：潔西卡這個月底能帶領新進員工的訓練課程嗎？ B：不行，她父親手術後她要照顧他，所以申請了兩週的帶薪【休假】，因此改由人資部門的湯姆來主持。

VOCAB.en_def: to become calm and stop worrying

VOCAB.sentence: A: Are you going to join us for the early morning bike ride along the river this Saturday? B: I'm afraid not, because I've worked overtime every night this week, so I really want to {{BLANK}} until ten o'clock and then have a slow breakfast at home with my family.

VOCAB.en_def: a short sleep during the day
VOCAB.sentence: A: How do you stay so energetic during the afternoon when everyone else in the department looks tired after lunch? B: I usually take a twenty-minute {{BLANK}} in the quiet room on the fifth floor, and when I wake up, I can focus on my work again until six.

VOCAB.en_def: to relax after a period of work or stress
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the company decide to build a small garden with benches on the roof of the office building last year? B: The managers wanted to give employees a pleasant place where they could {{BLANK}} during their lunch hour, because many people were feeling stressed by the heavy workload.
VOCAB.cn: A：公司去年為什麼決定在辦公大樓頂樓蓋一座有長椅的小花園？ B：主管們想給員工一個舒適的地方，讓他們可以在午休時間【放鬆身心】，因為很多人被繁重的工作量壓得很有壓力。

VOCAB.en_def: to get back your energy by resting
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why are you taking three days off right after the busy product launch, when there are still so many emails to answer? B: I've been working twelve hours a day for a month, so I need time to {{BLANK}} at the beach before I start planning the next big project with the team.
VOCAB.cn: A：產品發表會忙完後還有那麼多郵件要回，你為什麼馬上要請三天假？ B：我已經連續一個月每天工作十二小時了，所以在和團隊開始規劃下一個大案子之前，我需要時間在海邊【充電】一下。
VOCAB.collocation: recharge your batteries 恢復精力

VOCAB.en_def: to make someone feel less tired or hot
VOCAB.sentence: A: The workshop has been going on for three hours, so should we continue with the next topic or stop for a while? B: Let's stop for fifteen minutes so everyone can get some fresh air and {{BLANK}} themselves with cold drinks, and then we'll start the discussion about the new budget.
VOCAB.cn: A：工作坊已經進行三個小時了，我們要繼續下一個主題還是先停一下？ B：我們休息十五分鐘，讓大家呼吸新鮮空氣、喝杯冷飲【提神】一下，然後再開始討論新預算。
VOCAB.collocation: refresh yourself with a drink 喝杯飲料提神

VOCAB.en_def: time when you are not working and can do what you enjoy

VOCAB.cn: A：那家軟體公司薪水不算高，為什麼這麼多年輕工程師想去那裡工作？ B：公司讓員工一週只上四天班，所以他們有更多【休閒】時間可以和朋友相處、運動，或在辦公室以外學習新技能。

VOCAB.sentence: A: The publisher wants the cover of the new children's cookbook finished by the end of the month, but our designer is still on vacation. B: Don't worry, I have already contacted a freelance artist who can draw a colorful {{BLANK}} of a family cooking together, and she promised to send us the first sketch by Friday.

VOCAB.en_def: a long thin mark made with a pen or pencil

VOCAB.en_def: the activity or skill of looking at and understanding written words

MCQS.q: The application form does not ask for an applicant's age or _____. Hiring decisions are based only on skills and experience.
The airline wants to hire more _____ flight attendants this year. Currently, most of its cabin crew members are women.

The marketing team created a new logo and slogan for the hotel. They hope this fresh brand _____ will attract younger travelers.
Ms. Park will play a key _____ in the merger negotiations. She has handled similar deals in Japan and Korea.
The new policy supports gender _____ in the workplace. Men and women in the same position will receive equal pay.
The foundation aims to promote _____ in education. It provides extra resources to schools in poorer neighborhoods.
The advertisement was criticized for showing only women doing housework. Critics said it repeated an outdated _____.
All interviewers must complete training on unconscious _____. The course helps them judge applicants more fairly.
The law protects workers from _____ based on age or gender. Employers who break it may face heavy fines.
The company highly values _____ in its workforce. Its employees come from more than twenty different countries and cultures.
The new manager wants to create an _____ workplace. Everyone should feel welcome regardless of age or background.
The firm allows freedom of _____ in its dress code. Staff may wear what they like as long as it is neat.
The new men's cologne comes in a dark blue bottle. The designers wanted the packaging to look strong and _____.
The store's new spring line includes many soft colors and flowing dresses. Its style is elegant and _____.
The updated handbook now uses gender-_____ language throughout. For example, the word chairman has been replaced with chairperson in every section.
Some employees list their preferred _____ in their email signatures. This helps colleagues address them correctly.
All customers should be treated with _____ at our stores. Staff must remain polite even during busy periods.
The union held a seminar about employees' _____ under the new labor law. Topics included overtime pay and parental leave.
Shareholders demanded better _____ of women on the board. Currently, only one of the twelve directors is female.
Ms. Lin is a strong _____ for equal pay. She often speaks at business conferences about closing the wage gap.
The campaign aims to raise public _____ of workplace harassment. Posters will be displayed in every office.
The flexible work policy has gained wide _____ among staff. Over ninety percent of employees support the change.
The company has zero _____ for harassment of any kind. Employees who break this rule will be dismissed immediately.
The startup is known for its relaxed company _____. Employees often share lunch and brainstorm ideas together.
Working from home two days a week has become the _____ in our industry. Most competitors now offer similar arrangements.
The company offers free counseling to all staff. It believes _____ health is just as important as physical health.
Please do not use the office printer for _____ documents. It should be used only for company business.
The firm consulted a lawyer before changing its hiring rules. It wanted to be sure the policy met all _____ requirements.
After the presentation, the trainer led a group _____ on fair hiring. Participants shared their own experiences.

VOCAB.en_def: a low area of land between hills or mountains, often with a river
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why does the winery in that area produce such good grapes every year, even when the weather in other places is bad? B: The farm sits in a sheltered {{BLANK}} between two mountains, so strong winds cannot reach the vines, and a small river gives them enough water.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼那一帶的酒莊每年都能種出那麼好的葡萄，即使其他地方天氣很差也一樣？ B：那座農場位於兩座山之間一個受保護的【山谷】，所以強風吹不到葡萄藤，而且一條小河提供它們足夠的水。
VOCAB.collocation: a deep green valley 深綠色的山谷

VOCAB.en_def: a large area of flat land with few trees
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the logistics company choose that area for its new distribution center instead of the cheaper land near the hills? B: It is on a wide, flat {{BLANK}} with good highways, so large trucks can drive in and out easily and the building is simple to expand later.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼物流公司選那個地區蓋新的配送中心，而不是選山丘附近比較便宜的土地？ B：它位於一片寬廣平坦的【平原】上，有良好的公路，所以大卡車可以輕鬆進出，而且建築物以後也很容易擴建。
VOCAB.collocation: a vast coastal plain 廣闊的沿海平原

VOCAB.en_def: a large area of high, flat land
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did several of our engineers feel tired and short of breath during the first days of the project in the west of China? B: The work site is on a high {{BLANK}} about four thousand meters above sea level, so the air is thin and people need time to get used to it.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼我們有幾位工程師在中國西部的專案頭幾天覺得很累又喘不過氣？ B：工地位於海拔約四千公尺的【高原】上，所以空氣稀薄，大家需要時間來適應。
VOCAB.collocation: the Tibetan Plateau 青藏高原

VOCAB.en_def: a large, dry area of land with very little rain and few plants
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why does the solar energy company want to build its largest power station so far away from the cities in the north? B: The land is a huge {{BLANK}} where it almost never rains, so there is strong sunshine every day and nobody needs the empty ground for farming or houses.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼那家太陽能公司想把最大的發電廠蓋在離北部城市那麼遠的地方？ B：那片土地是一大片幾乎從不下雨的【沙漠】，所以每天都有強烈的陽光，而且沒有人需要那塊空地來耕種或蓋房子。
VOCAB.collocation: cross the desert 穿越沙漠

VOCAB.en_def: a large area of land covered with trees
VOCAB.sentence: A: Where are we taking the new employees for the outdoor training day next Friday, and what should they wear for the activities? B: We are going to a national {{BLANK}} park an hour away, so they should wear comfortable shoes because the walking paths go through thick trees and wet ground.
VOCAB.cn: A：下週五的戶外訓練日我們要帶新進員工去哪裡？他們活動時該穿什麼？ B：我們要去一小時車程外的國家【森林】公園，所以他們應該穿舒適的鞋子，因為步道會穿過茂密的樹林和潮濕的地面。
VOCAB.collocation: a protected forest area 受保護的森林區

VOCAB.en_def: a piece of land with water all around it
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why do the prices of fruit and vegetables at the hotel restaurant seem much higher than in the city where our head office is? B: The hotel is on a small {{BLANK}}, so almost all food must come by boat from the mainland, and the shipping costs are added to every dish.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼飯店餐廳的水果和蔬菜價格看起來比我們總公司所在的城市高很多？ B：飯店位於一座小【島】上，所以幾乎所有食物都必須從本島用船運來，運費都被加進了每道菜裡。
VOCAB.collocation: a tropical island 熱帶島嶼

VOCAB.en_def: a long piece of land that is mostly surrounded by water but joined to a larger area
VOCAB.sentence: A: The client wants to visit three cities in Korea next month, but how will the travel agent plan such a busy trip in only five days? B: Korea is a {{BLANK}}, so the cities are not very far apart, and the fast trains can take them from one coast to another in a few hours.
VOCAB.cn: A：客戶下個月想去韓國的三個城市，但旅行社要怎麼在只有五天內安排這麼緊湊的行程？ B：韓國是一個【半島】，所以城市之間不會太遠，而且高速列車幾個小時內就能帶他們從一邊的海岸到另一邊。
VOCAB.collocation: the Korean Peninsula 朝鮮半島

VOCAB.en_def: the land next to the sea
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why are so many of the hotel's guests from overseas booking rooms with a balcony on the east side of the building this year? B: The east side faces the {{BLANK}}, so guests can watch the sunrise over the water and hear the waves while they eat breakfast outside.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼今年飯店有那麼多外國客人都訂大樓東側附陽台的房間？ B：東側面向【海岸】，所以客人可以看到海上的日出，在外面吃早餐時還能聽到海浪聲。
VOCAB.collocation: along the east coast 沿著東海岸

VOCAB.en_def: the land along the edge of a sea, lake or wide river
VOCAB.sentence: A: The tour group wants to go fishing at the lake during their visit, but do they need to rent a boat from the resort? B: No, they can fish from the {{BLANK}} near the hotel garden, because there is a wooden deck there with chairs, lights and enough space for ten people.
VOCAB.cn: A：旅行團在參觀期間想去湖邊釣魚，他們需要向度假村租船嗎？ B：不用，他們可以在飯店花園附近的【岸邊】釣魚，因為那裡有一座木製平台，有椅子、燈，空間也夠十個人使用。
VOCAB.collocation: walk along the shore 沿著岸邊散步

VOCAB.en_def: an area of water near the land where ships can stay safely
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the shipping manager say our container of electronics will arrive two days later than the date on the original schedule? B: A storm closed the {{BLANK}} in Keelung for two days, so all the cargo ships had to wait outside until it was safe to enter and unload.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼航運經理說我們那個貨櫃的電子產品會比原本行程表上的日期晚兩天到？ B：一場暴風雨讓基隆【港】關閉了兩天，所以所有貨船都必須在外面等，直到可以安全進港卸貨。
VOCAB.collocation: boats in the harbor 港口裡的船隻

VOCAB.en_def: the official line that separates two countries or areas
VOCAB.sentence: A: How long will it take for the truck carrying our machine parts to get from the factory in Germany to our customer in France? B: It is only a short drive, but the truck must stop at the {{BLANK}} for a quick check of the documents, so I expect delivery tomorrow afternoon.
VOCAB.cn: A：載著我們機器零件的卡車從德國工廠到法國客戶那裡要多久？ B：其實車程很短，但卡車必須在【邊界】停下來快速檢查文件，所以我預計明天下午會送達。
VOCAB.collocation: cross the border 越過邊境

VOCAB.en_def: relating to a city or town
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why does our bicycle company sell so many folding bikes in Taipei but very few in the farming villages in the south? B: People in {{BLANK}} areas live in small apartments and take the metro to work, so they need a light bike that they can carry easily and store inside.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼我們的自行車公司在台北賣出很多摺疊車，但在南部的農村卻賣得很少？ B：【都市】地區的人住在小公寓裡，搭捷運上班，所以他們需要一台可以輕鬆攜帶並放在室內的輕便自行車。
VOCAB.collocation: urban development 都市發展

VOCAB.en_def: relating to the countryside, not the city
VOCAB.sentence: A: The bank wants to open more branches next year, but why is the manager planning to send mobile service vans instead of building offices? B: Many customers in {{BLANK}} villages live far from town, so a van that visits each village once a week is cheaper and more convenient for them.
VOCAB.cn: A：銀行明年想開更多分行，但為什麼經理打算派行動服務車，而不是蓋辦公室？ B：很多住在【鄉村】的客戶離市區很遠，所以每週到每個村莊一次的服務車對他們來說更便宜也更方便。
VOCAB.collocation: rural areas 鄉村地區

VOCAB.en_def: existing in nature and not made or caused by people
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the resort decide to keep the old rocks and trees around the swimming pool instead of building a modern garden? B: The owner believes guests prefer {{BLANK}} beauty, so the designers kept the waterfall, the big stones and the local plants exactly as they were.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼度假村決定保留游泳池周圍的老岩石和樹木，而不是蓋一座現代化花園？ B：老闆相信客人比較喜歡【自然】之美，所以設計師把瀑布、大石頭和當地植物都保持原狀。
VOCAB.collocation: natural resources 天然資源

VOCAB.en_def: relating to the real shape and features of land, or to the body
VOCAB.cn_def: 自然地理的；身體的；實體的
VOCAB.sentence: A: The new staff member keeps getting lost when she drives to our customers' farms, so what kind of map should we give her? B: Give her a {{BLANK}} map that shows the hills, rivers and valleys, because the small roads out there are not on most phone apps.
VOCAB.cn: A：新同事開車去客戶的農場時一直迷路，我們應該給她哪一種地圖？ B：給她一張標示山丘、河流和山谷的【地形】圖，因為那邊的小路在大部分手機應用程式上都找不到。
VOCAB.collocation: physical geography 自然地理學

VOCAB.en_def: relating to people, not to nature or machines
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did the city planners invite a university professor to the meeting about the new highway through the old town? B: She studies {{BLANK}} geography, so she can explain how the road will change the way people live, shop and travel in that neighborhood.
VOCAB.cn: A：為什麼都市規劃人員邀請一位大學教授來參加關於穿越舊城區新公路的會議？ B：她研究【人文】地理，所以她可以解釋這條路會如何改變那個社區居民的生活、購物和交通方式。
VOCAB.collocation: human geography 人文地理學

MCQS.q: Please bring a printed _____ of the factory site. The phone signal there is weak, and the roads are not marked clearly.
The airline's new advertisement shows planes flying around the _____. It wants customers to know that it serves cities everywhere.
Asia is the largest _____ in the world. Our company now has offices in eight of its countries.
Applicants must have a passport valid for travel to any _____ in Europe. The job requires frequent trips to clients abroad.
Our sales in the coastal _____ rose by twelve percent last quarter. The manager credits the new delivery service for the growth.
The architect designed the hotel to fit into the surrounding _____. Its low roof and stone walls match the hills and fields nearby.
The new delivery vans have large tires for rough _____. They can travel safely on muddy roads in the mountain villages.
Tea farmers prefer this area because of its cool _____. The temperature stays mild and the rain is steady throughout the year.
The outdoor product launch was moved indoors because of bad _____. Strong winds and heavy rain were expected all day.
The research station is located at a high _____ near the North Pole. Winters there are long, dark and extremely cold.
Each line of _____ runs from the North Pole to the South Pole. Sailors use these lines to find their position at sea.
Countries near the _____ have warm weather all year. Our air conditioner sales in those markets are steady every month.
Summer in the southern _____ begins in December. Our Australian stores therefore launch their swimwear collection before Christmas.
The cargo ship took twenty days to cross the Atlantic _____. Bad weather in the middle of the trip slowed it down.
Many hotels along the beach have rooms facing the _____. Guests can listen to the waves from their balconies.
The factory is built next to a wide _____. Boats carry raw materials to the plant from the port every week.
The resort offers kayaks on the _____ every morning. Guests can also walk the trail that goes around the water.
Engineers built a long tunnel through the _____ last year. The new route has cut travel time between the two cities by an hour.
The company's head office stands on a small _____ above the town. Visitors can see the whole harbor from its top floor.
Rice farms fill the green _____ between the two mountain ranges. A river provides water for the fields all year.
Grass and wheat cover the wide, flat _____ in the center of the country. The area is ideal for large farms and warehouses.
Snow often closes the roads across the high _____ in winter. Drivers should check road reports before starting the trip.
Tourists can join a guided camel ride across the _____. Guides provide plenty of water because temperatures often go above forty degrees.

VOCAB.en_def: happening near the beginning of the day or a period
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why did you book the six-thirty train to the head office when the meeting doesn't start until ten o'clock? B: I prefer an {{BLANK}} start on meeting days, because the trains are less crowded and I can review the sales figures quietly in the café before everyone arrives.
VOCAB.cn: A：會議十點才開始，你為什麼訂了六點半往總公司的火車？ B：開會的日子我喜歡【早一點】出發，因為火車比較不擁擠，我還能在大家到達之前，先在咖啡館安靜地檢查銷售數字。
VOCAB.collocation: make an early start 早早出發

VOCAB.en_def: the time when daylight first appears in the morning
VOCAB.sentence: A: The photographer wants to take pictures of the new hotel building for our brochure, but when is the best time to do it? B: She plans to arrive at {{BLANK}}, because the soft light at that time makes the glass walls look warm and the streets are still empty of cars.
VOCAB.cn: A：攝影師想替我們的手冊拍新飯店大樓的照片，什麼時候拍最好？ B：她打算在【黎明】時抵達，因為那時柔和的光線會讓玻璃牆看起來很溫暖，而且街上還沒有車子。
VOCAB.collocation: at dawn 在黎明時

VOCAB.en_def: the time when the sun first appears in the sky
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our company is planning a team-building trip to the mountains next month, so what activity do you think the staff would enjoy most? B: I think a short walk up to the lookout point to watch the {{BLANK}} together would be great, and then we could all share a hot breakfast at the lodge.
VOCAB.cn: A：公司下個月要辦一趟到山上的團隊建立旅行，你覺得員工最喜歡什麼活動？ B：我覺得一起短程步行到觀景台看【日出】會很棒，之後大家可以在山屋一起吃熱騰騰的早餐。
VOCAB.collocation: watch the sunrise 看日出

VOCAB.en_def: the early part of the day, from when the sun rises until noon
VOCAB.sentence: A: When would be a good time to call the supplier in Singapore about the late shipment of printer paper and ink? B: Try calling them first thing tomorrow {{BLANK}}, because their office opens at eight and the manager usually answers phone calls before her daily meetings begin.
VOCAB.cn: A：什麼時候打電話給新加坡的供應商詢問印表機紙和墨水延遲出貨的事比較好？ B：明天【早上】一上班就打給他們吧，因為他們的辦公室八點開門，而經理通常會在每日會議開始前接電話。
VOCAB.collocation: first thing in the morning 一早第一件事

VOCAB.en_def: to stop sleeping
VOCAB.sentence: A: How do you manage to get to the gym before work when you live so far away from the city center? B: I {{BLANK}} up at five without an alarm clock now, because after a few weeks my body got used to the new schedule and I actually feel more relaxed all day.
VOCAB.cn: A：你住得離市中心那麼遠，怎麼還能在上班前去健身房？ B：我現在不用鬧鐘五點就會【醒來】，因為幾個星期後我的身體就習慣了新的作息，而且我整天其實都覺得比較放鬆。
VOCAB.collocation: wake up early 早起

VOCAB.en_def: to wake up, or to make someone stop sleeping (formal)
VOCAB.sentence: A: Is the hotel near the airport a good choice for our visitors, or will the noise from the planes keep them up all night? B: The rooms have thick windows, so guests are not likely to {{BLANK}} because of the planes, and the hotel also offers a free shuttle bus to the terminal.
VOCAB.cn: A：機場附近的那家飯店適合我們的訪客嗎？還是飛機的噪音會讓他們整晚睡不著？ B：房間有很厚的窗戶，所以客人不太可能因為飛機而被【吵醒】，而且飯店還提供到航廈的免費接駁車。
VOCAB.collocation: be awakened by a noise 被噪音吵醒

VOCAB.en_def: to get out of bed after sleeping
VOCAB.sentence: A: How has your life changed since you started working at the bakery downtown last spring? B: The biggest change is that I have to {{BLANK}} at four o'clock every day, because the bread must be baked and placed in the window before the first customers come in at seven.
VOCAB.cn: A：自從你去年春天開始在市區麵包店工作，你的生活有什麼改變？ B：最大的改變是我每天必須四點就【起床】，因為麵包必須在七點第一批客人進來之前烤好並擺上櫥窗。
VOCAB.collocation: rise early 早起

VOCAB.en_def: a clock or sound that wakes you up at a set time
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why were you almost late for the important client presentation this morning, when you are usually the first person in the office? B: My phone battery died during the night, so the {{BLANK}} didn't go off, and luckily my neighbor knocked on my door when he was leaving for work.
VOCAB.cn: A：你平常總是第一個到辦公室，為什麼今天早上重要的客戶簡報差點遲到？ B：我的手機電池半夜沒電了，所以【鬧鐘】沒響，幸好我的鄰居出門上班時來敲了我的門。
VOCAB.collocation: set the alarm for six 把鬧鐘設在六點

VOCAB.en_def: a plan that lists the times when things will happen
VOCAB.sentence: A: Do you think we can fit a training session for the new staff into next week, since everyone seems so busy? B: Let me check the {{BLANK}} first, but I believe Tuesday morning is open, because the monthly sales meeting was moved to Thursday afternoon.
VOCAB.cn: A：大家好像都很忙，你覺得下週能排進一場新進員工訓練嗎？ B：我先查一下【行程表】，不過我相信星期二早上有空，因為每月的業務會議已經改到星期四下午了。
VOCAB.collocation: a busy schedule 繁忙的行程

VOCAB.en_def: the usual things you do and the order you do them in
VOCAB.sentence: A: How do you always stay so calm and organized, even on days when there are many problems in the warehouse? B: I follow the same {{BLANK}} every day: I arrive early, read my emails, check the stock list, and then talk to the team before any trucks arrive.
VOCAB.cn: A：即使倉庫問題很多的日子，你怎麼總能保持冷靜又有條理？ B：我每天都遵循相同的【例行程序】：提早到、讀電子郵件、檢查庫存清單，然後在卡車到達前先和團隊談話。
VOCAB.collocation: a daily routine 日常例行事務

VOCAB.en_def: something you do often and regularly, often without thinking
VOCAB.sentence: A: Your sales reports are always finished before the deadline, so what is your secret for staying ahead of your work? B: I made it a {{BLANK}} to write for thirty minutes before anyone else comes in, because the office is quiet then and I can think clearly without phone calls.
VOCAB.cn: A：你的業務報告總是在截止日前完成，你保持工作超前的秘訣是什麼？ B：我養成了在別人進來之前先寫三十分鐘的【習慣】，因為那時辦公室很安靜，沒有電話打擾，我可以清楚地思考。
VOCAB.collocation: form a good habit 養成好習慣

VOCAB.en_def: the ability to control yourself and do what you should do
VOCAB.sentence: A: Our new marketing assistant studies for an MBA at night and still arrives at work early every day, so how does she do it? B: She has a lot of {{BLANK}}, because she goes to bed at ten, never skips her study hours, and turns off her phone when she needs to focus.
VOCAB.cn: A：我們新來的行銷助理晚上在讀企管碩士，每天還是很早到公司，她是怎麼做到的？ B：她非常【自律】，因為她十點就上床、從不跳過讀書時間，而且需要專心時就會關掉手機。
VOCAB.collocation: self-discipline / strict discipline 嚴格的自律

VOCAB.en_def: to make someone feel less tired and more full of energy
VOCAB.sentence: A: You look much happier than you did yesterday, so did something good happen at the meeting with the new client? B: Not really, but I took a short walk in the park before work today, and the cool air helped {{BLANK}} my mind after a long week of late nights.
VOCAB.cn: A：你看起來比昨天開心多了，和新客戶的會議有什麼好消息嗎？ B：其實沒有，不過我今天上班前在公園短暫散步了一下，涼爽的空氣幫助我在熬夜了一整週之後【恢復】精神。
VOCAB.collocation: refresh your mind 讓頭腦清醒

VOCAB.en_def: having a lot of energy and being very active
VOCAB.sentence: A: Why do you think the morning shift workers at the factory are so much faster than the night shift workers? B: Most of them have had a good night's sleep and a healthy breakfast, so they feel {{BLANK}} and can work carefully on the production line for many hours.
VOCAB.cn: A：你覺得為什麼工廠早班的工人比夜班的工人快那麼多？ B：他們大多睡了一夜好覺，也吃了健康的早餐，所以感覺【精力充沛】，可以在生產線上仔細工作好幾個小時。
VOCAB.collocation: feel energetic 感到精力充沛

VOCAB.en_def: able to think quickly and notice things
